violations: Write-off approval 'never the requester (409 SAME_SIGNER)' goes against owner decision 27. That rule exempts the CEO from separation of duties, and lib/separation-of-duties.ts:38-46 assertNotSelfApproval is THE helper, so a separate check is a duplicate. Because only ADMIN_ONLY can approve, a write-off the CEO raises would be stuck forever. Fix: call assertNotSelfApproval (the CEO is exempt), or apply a CEO-raised request at once, the same way the plan already treats a client the CEO creates. Drop the provider's disabledReason for requestedById===ctx.user.id.

The approval providers leave out `delegable`. ApprovalProvider requires it (approvals/types.ts:128), and the cash_voucher provider the plan copies is `delegable: true` (providers.ts:471). The owner said 'BAD DEBT: CEO approves every one' and 'RAAST void: CEO ONLY'. Fix: set delegable: false on bad_debt and raast_void, and on on_account_client too, which is the safest choice.

The daily 'self-healing' till-clearing sweep moves EVERY 1110 line that is not 'receivable.*' and not 'ON ACCOUNT' to 1115. That includes manual journals finance posts on purpose (sourceType 'manual', accounting/routes.ts:204), and the books would be reclassified silently with nobody approving it. Fix: run the full sweep once, as a cutover (marker in settings, the same pattern as applyModuleGrants). After that, the daily run moves only reversals of pre-cutover till-clearing entries (references ending '.reversal' whose original was pre-cutover). Any other new non-AR 1110 line, manual ones included, is FLAGGED in the tie-out or as an exception and never moved automatically.

The on-account eligibility test `completionDoor(order)==='payment'` is not the rule that actually completes the sale. applyCoverageTx (pos/service.ts:562) completes when `order.source==='pos' || (via==='till' && order.fulfilmentType==='dine_in')`. If the two disagree, an on_account 'paid' row sits on an order that never went through completeOrder: no fiscal document, the charge is still on the client's account, and the paid-open-order void path (pos/service.ts:2156) can write an on_account refund. That breaks 'every sale change flows through completeOrder'. Fix: inside the charge transaction, require `coverage.completedNow === true` after applyCoverageTx, otherwise throw 409 ON_ACCOUNT_NOT_HERE so the whole transaction rolls back. Use the same predicate for eligibility.

'The whole bill is re-priced at the CASH tax class' is not guaranteed. tenderPriceOf (pos/service.ts:896-917) skips the re-price when there is a promo, wallet, tip or gift card on the bill, or no taxRatePct. A bill rung up at the card rate (8%) with a promo would stay at 8% on account. That contradicts the plan's own tax assumption and lib/pricing's rule that the customer is never billed less than they owe. Fix: after repriceForTenderTx, require order.taxRatePct === concept.taxRateCash, otherwise 409 ON_ACCOUNT_RATE (re-ring without credits). Also refuse on account when any wallet, gift-card or loyalty credit or a pending check-split portion is on the bill.

Raast void with no ledger entry leaves the cancelled ticket's 'refund due' alive. refundDueOf (pos/service.ts:2893) and refundDueCents (orderPosting.ts:187) still count the paid Raast Payment. The till then offers 'Refund to Raast', which fails because chooseRaastRefundSourceTx only picks receipts that are provisional or matched (raastTender.ts:480). And a hand-back booked before the void (Dr 1110/1115 / Cr bank) would be left stranded. Fix: eligibility also requires that no refund row on the order points at this receipt (gatewayMeta.raast.receiptId). After the void, refundDueOf, refundDueCents and the Z-report's cancelledPaid exclude payments whose raastReceipt.status is 'voided'. Any refund of that money goes through finance's bank adjustment.

Charge-refund bookkeeping is hooked only in refundOrder. writeRefundTx is shared by the void-on-paid-order path (service.ts:2156) and the cancelled-ticket hand-back (3378), so those paths would skip it. Fix: call applyChargeRefundTx inside writeRefundTx whenever r.method==='on_account', so no writer of an on_account refund row can skip the charge and statement update.

The bad-debt recovery reversal is not handled. The existing reverse route (receivables/routes.ts:661-712) only moves paidCents and whtCents and reverses 'receivable.payment'. For a payment with writeOffId it must also decrement ReceivableWriteOff.recoveredCents and restore writtenOffCents, in the same transaction, otherwise OVER_RECOVERY blocks a later real recovery and the write-off record overstates.

Statements must claim only charges whose sale is BOOKED: the home drawer's shift.close is posted, or order.complete is posted for a group bill. Charges still on an open or failed drawer are listed as 'not billed yet'. Otherwise a statement can be paid (Cr 1110) before 1110 was ever debited, and the tie-out breaks.

Integration with the tax area's H13 sales-tax withholding (receivable.stwh). It finds the authority from the invoice's 'receivable.issue' entry, but a statement has no issue entry and conceptId may be null. Define the statement's authority from its charges' brands (outputTaxCodeFor), and refuse or split when the charges span two authorities.

code_facts: Order has no tenantId column (schema model Order: conceptId only). The till scopes orders with `concept: { deletedAt: null, ...(await scopeTenantWhere(req, 'write')) }` (pos/routes.ts:246), and the company is order.concept.tenantId. The plan's 'order from scopeTenantWhere(req,"write")' has to be written this way.

The completion rule is applyCoverageTx `completes = order.source === 'pos' || (via === 'till' && order.fulfilmentType === 'dine_in')` (pos/service.ts:562). completionDoor (orders/service.ts:2085) is pos OR rawPayload.channel 'group_order'. Group orders are stored as fulfilment 'dine_in' with a pending 'split' placeholder payment (groupOrders/routes.ts:403-411).

tenderPriceOf returns null (no re-price) for: taxRatePct null, !isTillSale (storefront dine-in is excluded), promo/wallet/tip > 0, gift-card redemptions, or a rate that already matches (pos/service.ts:896-917).

Rollback statement is wrong. An older Prisma client THROWS when it reads an enum value it does not know ('on_account' in PaymentMethod, 'voided' in RaastReceiptStatus). After a rollback, the shift close, Z-report, order screens and Raast tab would crash on those rows; they would not fall into 1030. Suspending clients first does not help once any on_account row exists.

REPOSTERS entries are `{ entityType, title, nothingToPost, load(sourceId, flag) → RefusedDoc{ tenantId, date, orderId, what, amountCents, post(opts) } }` (backfillOrders.ts:343-350). A flag is reposted only when metadata.sourceId === entityId (backfillOrders.ts:577). So the sweep's flagPostingFailed must use sourceId = tenantId, not '<tenantId>:<n>', and 'ledger.till_clearing_split' must be added to RefusedPostingKind.

receivables/routes.ts already EXPORTS totalOf, balanceOf, statusFor and paymentKind. Only lockInvoice, restatus, nextNumber, withNumberRetry and assertLiveInvoice are private (routes.ts:94-187). The tax area (tax_people plan) also edits paymentKind/SOURCE_OF_KIND and the withholding route in that file. Exporting the four helpers is less churn than moving them to receivables/ledger.ts. If they are moved, do it first, as orchestrator prework.
paymentLabelOf takes only { method, gatewayRef } (pos/receipt.ts:57). Showing the client name needs gatewayMeta, so the signature and its callers change.

sendEmail (lib/notify.ts:57) is the ONE platform SMTP, not per company. 'statement emails through the company SMTP' is wrong; the sender is the platform address, so add a per-company reply-to or say so.

refundDueOf (pos/service.ts:2893-2915) builds byMethod from REFUNDABLE_TENDERS (= lib/tenders REFUND_TENDERS). Adding on_account to REFUND_TENDERS puts on_account into cancelled-ticket refund-due unless refundDueOf excludes it too; the plan names only orderPosting refundDueCents.

corrected_plan_notes:
1. On-account eligibility: use the applyCoverageTx completion rule, not completionDoor. Inside the charge transaction, require coverage.completedNow, otherwise 409 and the transaction rolls back.
2. Refuse on account when the bill carries a promo, wallet, gift card, loyalty credit, a tip, or a pending check-split portion. After repriceForTenderTx, assert order.taxRatePct === concept.taxRateCash, otherwise 409 ON_ACCOUNT_RATE.
3. Call applyChargeRefundTx inside writeRefundTx for every on_account refund row, not only in refundOrder. Exclude on_account in refundDueOf as well as refundDueCents.
4. Write-off approval: use assertNotSelfApproval (the CEO is exempt, decision 27), not SAME_SIGNER. A write-off the CEO raises applies at once.
5. Set `delegable: false` on the bad_debt and raast_void providers, and on on_account_client.
6. Bad-debt recovery reversal: the existing reverse route must also decrement recoveredCents and restore writtenOffCents when the payment has a writeOffId.
7. Till-clearing split:
   - Keep 1115 and the dual-code legacy lookups.
   - Run the sweep ONCE as a cutover, recorded with a settings marker.
   - Afterwards the daily job moves only reversals of pre-cutover till-clearing entries. Any other non-AR 1110 activity, manual journals included, is flagged and never moved automatically.
   - Flag a failed sweep with sourceId = tenantId, and add the kind to RefusedPostingKind using the real Reposter shape (load → RefusedDoc.post).
8. Statements claim only charges whose sale is booked: the drawer close is posted, or order.complete is posted for a group bill.
9. Statement sales-tax withholding: take the authority from the charges' brands, and refuse or split when the charges span two authorities. Coordinate with the tax area's receivable.stwh.
10. Raast void eligibility adds: no refund row on the order against this receipt. After a void, refund-due, the Z-report's cancelledPaid and the till's hand-back options exclude payments whose receipt is 'voided'.
11. Rollback: say plainly that once any on_account or voided row exists the API image must not roll back (an older Prisma client throws on the unknown enum value), and add this to CLAUDE.md.
12. Prework the orchestrator lands first:
    - schema.prisma plus prisma generate;
    - the journal.ts constants;
    - tenders.ts ON_ACCOUNT_TENDER (included in the compile check);
    - lib/evidenceFile.ts, agreed with the cash-request area, which is replacing cashVouchers.ts, so no re-export shim is needed;
    - the approvals types;
    - stubs for exposureOfTx and assertChargeableTx.
    Prefer exporting the private receivables helpers over moving them.
13. Add to D1's file list: refunds/refundEngine.ts, orders/[id]/page.tsx and lib/api.ts. The orchestrator handles exceptions/page.tsx labels, the moduleCatalog MODULE_GAPS text, CLAUDE.md (remove G12/G14 from the pending list) and the docs/raast.md and on-account runbooks.
14. paymentLabelOf gains gatewayMeta. Statement email goes through the platform SMTP, with a per-company reply-to.
15. The UI gets server-provided capability flags instead of local role lists. Narrow the client-detail readers if fnb_manager should not see NTNs and limits.
16. Ask the owner or CA the targeted questions Q1-Q5 listed under missing. Build on the stated defaults until they answer: cash rate, CEO approves new clients and limit increases, block when overdue, no loyalty earn, a CEO-raised write-off applies at once.
